name: arkandia
description: Arkandia's toolkit of AI coding-agent skills. `agent-context-dotnet` bootstraps a documentation pack for a .NET repository — AGENTS.md, architecture, ADRs, data model, infrastructure, plus a `docs/dotnet.md` deep-dive covering the solution/project graph, target frameworks, central package management, Aspire, EF Core, DI, analyzers, packaging and CI — and validates the most important generated claims with you to reduce hallucinations. `linear-plan-build` and `ado-plan-build` take a ticket from read → grill you on the open design decisions → explore → plan → adversarial review → approval only when the change warrants it → test-first build → your repo's gates → PR → babysit CI to green; they share one engine and differ only in their bindings, Linear + GitHub for one and Azure Boards + Azure Repos + Pipelines for the other.
